type get_tpsa = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_fraction_csp3 = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Wildman–Crippen molar refractivity (MR).
type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return total ring count.
type get_ring_count = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic ring count.
type get_num_aromatic_rings = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return net formal charge (sum of atom formal charges as encoded in the SMILES).
type get_formal_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return QED (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness) as implemented in RDKit.
type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return heteroatom count (non C/H).
type get_num_heteroatoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Analyze fused ring systems (clusters of rings sharing bonds) and report their topology, aromaticity, and heteroatom content. Distinguishes fused polycyclic systems from isolated rings. type analyze_ring_systems = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type classify_ionization = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string,

ph?: number
}) => any;

type compute_similarity = (_: {

smiles: string,

reference_smiles: string[]

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

smiles: string

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_bertz_ct = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

smiles: string
}) => any;

}) => any;

}) => any;

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_esol = (_: {

smiles: string
